From the owner
We just completed one of our most stunning projects to date — the Harris Row Remodel in Manson, WA. This full whole-home renovation transformed every space in the house, starting with the kitchen. We removed the wall between the kitchen, dining room, and breakfast nook to open up the entire main living area. The result is one grand, connected space with custom cabinetry, mitered edge countertops, all-new high-end appliances, a warming drawer, and a built-in microwave. The fireplace became the home's defining statement piece — a full slab surround with a mitered black soapstone hearth that stops everyone the moment they walk in. The primary bathroom was reimagined as a full luxury spa: floor-to-ceiling tile, a wet room with freestanding soaking tub and rain shower, heated towel racks, and custom mirrors. Heated tile floors run throughout the home, and custom cabinetry was built for the mudroom and pantry. Every space. One team. One vision. Apex Building Services is a design-build firm serving the Lake Chelan Valley — Chelan, Manson, and beyond. We're a BIAW Certified Home Builder and proud members of CWHBA. Ready to start your project? Give us a call or visit apexbuildingservices.com.
Jul 22, 2026

Baltic birch plywood is considered the best cabinet box material because of three specific construction advantages over standard plywood: it has more plies at consistent thickness (13 plies in a 3/4” sheet vs 5–7 in domestic plywood), all plies are birch with no voids permitted at any layer, and it comes in 5×5 sheets that often reduce waste in cabinet cut lists. Trenton Wallpaper Installer provides wallpaper installation in Detroit, with careful attention to the way each pattern, texture, and finish comes together. Every project starts with the surface itself. Proper wall preparation helps create a smooth foundation, while accurate measuring and precise trimming keep the finished work looking tidy. Matching repeating patterns takes patience, and delicate or textured wallcoverings need a steady hand to preserve their appearance. These details may seem small, but they make a real difference to the final result. There are plenty of ways to make wallpaper work with your style, from understated designs that add quiet depth to striking prints that become the focus of a room. For Detroit property owners updating a home, office, or commercial interior, well installed wallcovering offers a distinctive finish that feels considered, balanced, and complete.

From the owner
When people reach out to us here in Asheville about updating their bathrooms, one of the first things they want to know is how the process actually works from start to finish. That makes a lot of sense, because a bathroom renovation involves more moving parts than most people expect going in. It usually starts with a conversation about scope. Are you updating fixtures and finishes, or are you changing the layout and moving plumbing? Those two paths look very different in terms of cost, timeline, and permitting requirements. From there, we put together a detailed scope of work before any demo happens. This protects everyone and keeps the project on track. In older Western North Carolina homes, we also plan ahead for things like subfloor rot or outdated pipes that can show up once walls come down. Permits for plumbing, electrical, and structural work are typically required in Buncombe County, and we handle that side of things so you do not have to figure it out on your own. If you want a closer look at the full process and what to expect on costs, our website goes into a lot more detail.
